methodology.blog: A benchmark receives a blog check only when launch prose discusses the model’s performance or limitations. Tables, image captions, setup notes and bare names do not qualify.
methodology.card: A card check requires numerical evaluation evidence for the released model. Table-of-contents entries, citations and results for other models do not qualify. Shared-card addenda are scoped to their own release.
methodology.ordering: Rows rank by the number of distinct release events with either qualifying tier. Version labels are preserved. A blank means no qualifying finding in this snapshot, not that a lab never ran the benchmark.
methodology.review: Deterministic source rules identify evidence candidates; classifications are open to correction. Raw sources and exact locations support review.
